name: 30 Point Black Tile
description: 30 Point Black Tile is a Hearts-style domino game using a double-six set: 30 penalty points per deal. Three or four players pass three tiles left; leader nominates suit each trick. Lowest total score wins. Same family as 11 Point and 21 Point Black Tile.

Hearts-style adaptation for double-six dominoes; 30 penalty points per deal. Same family as 11 Point and 21 Point Black Tile.

Three or four players use a double-six domino set. With three players each receives nine tiles and one tile remains face down; with four players each receives seven tiles. First player is chosen by drawing from the boneyard for highest pip total.
Tiles dealt; each player passes 3 face-down to the left before play.
